intro.title: Generators, Iterators & Proxy
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple data processing pipeline that uses JavaScript's advanced features to handle sequences of data. You'll learn the core concepts of Generators, which produce values on demand, Iterators, which define how to traverse data, and Proxy, which intercepts and customizes operations on objects. The main technologies involved are JavaScript's generator functions, the iterator protocol, and the Proxy object. By the end, you'll create a program that generates numbers, iterates through them, and logs access to an object using a proxy, all in a beginner-friendly way.
intro.usecase: Generators and iterators are essential for handling large datasets in modern web applications, such as infinite scrolling feeds in social media platforms or paginated data tables in analytics dashboards. Proxies enable reactive programming patterns by intercepting object operations, which powers frameworks like Vue.js for automatic UI updates when data changes. Developers use these patterns to create efficient data streaming in real-time dashboards, implement custom validation logic in complex forms, and build sophisticated state management systems that track user interactions across application panels and modals.
